description: A series compensator on an `Arc`: a series capacitor or reactor, or a thyristor-controlled or static synchronous series compensator, with one series reactance. Devices that also inject at a bus, such as a UPFC, are not covered.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the compensator. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power_flow.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the compensator. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

arc.description: An `Arc` defining this line `from` a bus `to` another bus.

r.description: Resistance. Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

x.description: Series reactance; negative for a capacitor. Under `DISPATCHABLE` and `ACTIVE_POWER_FLOW`, the present value. Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow through the compensator must be between -`rating` and `rating`. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVA, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

control_mode.description: How the series reactance is set. `FIXED` holds `x`; `BYPASSED` shorts the compensator into a zero-impedance tie; `DISPATCHABLE` makes the reactance a decision within `reactance_limits`; `ACTIVE_POWER_FLOW` sets it to hold `active_power_flow_setpoint`.

reactance_limits.description: Minimum and maximum series reactance. Required when `control_mode` is `DISPATCHABLE` or `ACTIVE_POWER_FLOW`. Units: per parameter_units — NATURAL_UNITS: ohm, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

active_power_flow_setpoint.description: Active power flow, from the `from` bus to the `to` bus, the compensator holds. Required when `control_mode` is `ACTIVE_POWER_FLOW`. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

rating_b.description: Second current rating. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVA, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

rating_c.description: Third current rating. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVA, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

operational_flow_limit.description: Operator-set minimum and maximum flow in each direction. Absent means no operational limit. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

base_power.description: System base power for per-unitization of this component's per-unit fields, recorded per component in lieu of a system-level table. Units: MVA.

power_units.description: Unit basis for this component's power-family fields (active/reactive/apparent power, ratings, limits, ramp rates). COMPONENT_BASE: per unit on this component's own base_power. NATURAL_UNITS: the field's physical unit.

parameter_units.description: Unit basis for r and x. COMPONENT_BASE is per-unit on this component's base_power, which records the system base.

title: SeriesCompensator
